tests.name: bson_output_standard_vector
tests.intent: Verify that converting a JSON object to BSON using a standard vector sink produces expected binary output.

tests.name: bson_output_empty_object
tests.intent: Verify BSON serialization of an empty JSON object.

tests.name: bson_output_nested_object
tests.intent: Verify BSON serialization of nested objects and multiple data types.

tests.name: bon8_output_basic
tests.intent: Verify that converting a JSON object to BON8 using a vector sink produces output.

tests.name: bson_output_array
tests.intent: Verify BSON serialization when the root JSON value is an array containing objects.

tests.name: bson_output_non_object_root
tests.intent: Verify BSON serialization behavior when the root is not an object (expecting an exception).

tests.name: bon8_output_nested
tests.intent: Verify BON8 serialization on complex nested structures.

tests.name: bson_output_char_vector
tests.intent: Verify BSON serialization using a char vector sink instead of uint8_t.

tests.name: bon8_output_char_vector
tests.intent: Verify BON8 serialization using a char vector sink.

tests.name: bson_output_custom_sink_iterator
tests.intent: Verify BSON writing into a back_insert_iterator of a vector.

tests.name: bson_output_large_numbers
tests.intent: Verify BSON serialization of large integer and floating point values.

tests.name: bson_output_binary_subtype
tests.intent: Verify BSON output when containing binary subtype data.

tests.name: bson_output_null_value
tests.intent: Verify BSON output containing null JSON values.

tests.name: bson_output_unicode_keys
tests.intent: Verify BSON output containing unicode strings in keys and values.

tests.name: bson_output_deep_nesting
tests.intent: Verify BSON output with deeply nested objects to test recursion limits or behavior.

tests.name: bon8_output_array_root
tests.intent: Verify BON8 serialization when root is an array.

tests.name: bson_output_multiple_calls
tests.intent: Verify that a single JSON instance can be serialized to BSON multiple times consistently.

tests.name: bson_output_error_handler_action
tests.intent: Verify BSON output invocation with specific error handler parameters.

tests.name: bson_output_empty_key
tests.intent: Verify BSON serialization when an object contains an empty string key.

tests.name: bson_output_many_fields
tests.intent: Verify BSON serialization with an object containing numerous fields.

tests.name: bson_output_custom_sink_iterator_fixed
tests.intent: Verify BSON writing into a back_insert_iterator of a vector.

tests.intent: Verify BSON writing into a back_insert_iterator of a vector.
